About DECIDE.

DECIDE. — Tarot as a Tool for Thinking

What is DECIDE.?

DECIDE. is a decision-support tool that helps you organize the decisions you're torn over in everyday life and find a way to decide for yourself.

It uses tarot not as fortune-telling, but as a way to put what you're torn about into words and think through your two options side by side. With the viewpoint of the card you draw and a record of your decisions, it helps you gather what you need to choose in a way you can stand by.

Who it's for

  • You think and think, but no answer comes
  • You keep turning the same thing over and over in your mind
  • You overthink even small things, and tend to regret your choice even after you've decided

It covers everything from small everyday choices — buy or not, go or not, moving house, plans for a day off, relationships with people close to you — to bigger choices such as changing jobs, leaving a job, love, marriage, and starting your own business.

What you can do

  • Draw tarot cards: Put what you're torn about into words and draw a card, and you'll gain a viewpoint you hadn't thought of yourself.
  • Decision log: You can record what you decided and why. Looking back later, you start to see your own patterns in how you decide.
  • Card guide: All 78 cards explained through the symbols depicted and their upright and reversed meanings (Guide to the meanings of all 78 tarot cards).
  • Reading: Articles on the theme of the decisions you're torn over and how to decide, with hints for organizing your thoughts (Reading list). You can also read by theme from Browse by decision.

How to use

  1. Put what you're torn about into words
  2. Draw a card
  3. Record what you decided and why

Open DECIDE. and you can start right away.

Price

For free, you get 5 card draws and 5 decision records.

The paid version, “UNLIMITED,” is a one-time purchase of ¥980 (tax included, no extra charges). The limits on card draws and records are removed, and cloud sync becomes available. To purchase and use UNLIMITED, you need to sign in with a Google account.

For returns and cancellations, please see the refund information in the FAQ below.

Frequently asked questions

Is this a fortune-telling app?

No. It does not predict your future. It uses tarot as a “viewpoint for thinking,” and it is a tool to help you decide for yourself in the end.

How much can I use for free?

You get 5 card draws and 5 decision records.

Is the price monthly?

No, it is a one-time purchase of ¥980 (tax included). There is no monthly fee and no extra charges.

Where are my records saved?

Records are saved on your device. With UNLIMITED, when you sign in, they sync to the cloud, so you can see the same records on another device.

What kinds of decisions can I use it for?

From everyday choices such as shopping, moving house, work, and relationships, to bigger decisions such as changing jobs or starting your own business.

Can I get a refund?

Due to the nature of digital content, we do not accept returns or cancellations after purchase. However, if there is a cause attributable to us — for example, if a defect prevents you from using the features of UNLIMITED EDITION — please contact us and we will provide a refund.
